kind: expected frozen before observed; normative claims remain per-case
scope: local synthetic quarantine; no S11, no COMPLETED

caseExpectations.network: only private Unix sockets and loopback; external connect denied
caseExpectations.coherentCut: Auth/Storage stopped and no business writers during full dump interval; before/after content equal
caseExpectations.restore: new clusters; full database and globals; exact all table columns/types/multiplicity/NULL/decimal hashes, owners/ACL/catalog/settings before startup
caseExpectations.authVariant: all Auth tables including users,factors,sessions,refresh,migrations and catalog preserved; serve without migrate
caseExpectations.storageVariant: full metadata and filesystem bytes; serve official app without migrate
caseExpectations.rotation: all restored keys disabled retained; separate new 32-byte F1/F2 keys and generations; readback before signers
caseExpectations.auth: actual password/TOTP, generation captured before TOTP; signature separately from online session/Core
caseExpectations.revocation: t0 and t1 and issuing sessions denied after completed/revoked; fresh full login allowed
caseExpectations.effects: durable t1 ledger outside rollback, counters unchanged on restore/reconcile; uncertain cannot restart; absent t1 attempts not fabricated
caseExpectations.objects: complete exact bytes; missing/incomplete/orphan/corrupt never complete; direct unauthorized download denied
caseExpectations.security: ordinary-role keys/tables/Auth/DDL denied with real permission codes; old proof/replay/mutation/projection/object denied
caseExpectations.concurrency: revocation before TOTP/establish denied; confirmed establish then revoke late response denied; late object bytes denied
caseExpectations.counterprobes: mutated owner/ACL/settings/table row/hash/decimal/type/multiplicity/old active key/false complete must fail
caseExpectations.measurements: UTC and monotonic durations, exact loss/counts with coverage limits; no invented RPO/RTO
